---
title: "Synthetic Population"
subtitle: "PopulationSim synthetic enrollment estimates, by district and county"

## Overview

This script produces the "synthetic" half of the validation schema — PopulationSim's estimate of
how many K-12 students and college students live in each district/county, to compare against the
real enrollment numbers from `2_enrollment.qmd`.

- **Objective**: for each district, count synthetic persons two ways — by enrollment status
  (`PersonType_Label == "K-12 student"`, **uncontrolled** in PopulationSim, so this is the real
  test) and by age band (5-17, a **controlled** variable, so a sanity bound rather than an exact
  match). Same two-way count for colleges by county, using `"University student"` and a college-age
  band, combining PopulationSim's regular household persons with its separate dorm/group-quarters
  student file.
- **What it reads**: PopulationSim's synthetic person/household output (local-only — gitignored in
  the `TDM-INP-PopulationSim` repo, so this script needs a local path to wherever that output
  actually lives on this machine, not a repo-relative path) and the block-level crosswalk from
  `1_geography.qmd`.
- **MAZ/TAZ join**: PopulationSim's output is keyed at MAZ/TAZ level, not Census block. The
  crosswalk from `1_geography.qmd` now carries `TAZID` per block (sourced from WFRC's
  [WasatchFrontTAZ](https://services1.arcgis.com/taguadKoI1XFwivx/ArcGIS/rest/services/WasatchFrontTAZ/FeatureServer/0)
  feature service), so district/county rollup can go through TAZID rather than needing a direct
  MAZ-to-block join — still need to confirm PopulationSim's output is keyed at this same TAZID
  (not a different internal MAZ id) before relying on it.
- **Box Elder**: handled last — the MPO/TDM model region only partially covers the county, so its
  synthetic counts need to be clipped to the model boundary (`1_geography.qmd`'s `model_boundary`
  layer) rather than compared at full-county scope like the other four counties.
- **Output**: synthetic enrollment-status and age-band counts, by district and by county, written
  to `_outputs/`.
